notes.title: HoloBall Multiplayer Beta is Live!
notes.content:
After a long wait, HoloBall PvP is finally ready for beta testing!
[img=http://i.imgur.com/QInLum5.png]
[b]We're looking for people to help us test the beta over the next couple of days, and we will be going live to the public this weekend![/b]

[b]If you're interested in joining the beta, and are able to put in some time testing:[/b]
[list]
[*] Download the latest steam build
[*] Please post any feedback here, on [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/holoballvr/]reddit[/url] or on our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/457320/discussions/]steam forums[/url]
[*] Thanks for your help, it's greatly appreciated!
[/list]
[b]Multiplayer Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Matches consist of 3 rounds, win 2 rounds to take the match
[*]First to 6 pts wins a round, but you must win by 2
[*]You can adjust your "Evil AI" voice in the lobby (activate the checkbox to hear yourself)
[*]There are 2-week "seasons", ending every Sunday. If you collect enough points, you can earn a trophy for the season. We will be adding leaderboards soon.
[*]When playing someone ranked below you, you will earn less points, and vice versa.
[*]Tractor-Beam is disabled in multiplayer
[*]Dead Balls will count as a point for your opponent
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.9.2: Japanese and Simplified Chinese localization
notes.content:

notes.title: Version 1.9: Tractor Beam, Arcade Mode, Better Haptics, Bug Fixes and more!
notes.content:
Hey guys, it's been a long time since the last update. We've been hard at work on optimizing performance and adding multiplayer.

The multiplayer beta is just around the corner, but in the meantime, please enjoy this new update that brings a lot of subtle improvements, big fixes and balancing tweaks. 

1.9 CHANGELOG
* Added: Enemy 'Charge Shot'
* Added Render Scale to settings
* Added "Trigger to Serve"
* Added Tractor Beam (press trigger when you 'own' the ball)
* Added: Arcade Mode
* Added: RTS-style camera controls to Spectator Cams using game pad

* Uodated: Better Performance
* Updated: Switched from Daily leaderboard to Weekly
* Updated: Rebalanced all game modes for smoother difficulty curve
* Updated: Easy mode is now 3 points / round

* Fixed: Multiple achievements not being awarded
* Fixed: Serve exploit while ball is spawning or when double-hitting ball.
* Fixed: TimePenalty not reset between rounds
* Fixed: ScoreGui not showing after final round
* Fixed: Ultimate Shutout Achievement not working
* Fixed: AI stats don't reset when restarting match

notes.title: Update #1.4
notes.content:
Sorry this update took so long, it started out as simply adding achievements and just grew and grew! 

In this version we totally overhauled the paddle physics, and put much more emphasis on your swing speed (no more wrist-flick garbage!). Due to the new physics, we had to completely re-balance all game modes, which was pretty scary considering the positive feedback we'd already received. Hopefully it's still as fun! 

Additionally, we weren't happy with the sweet spot implementation, it was way too easy to score with weak shots on your serve. Now, sweet spots are hidden when you're serving, and they only appear after the AI hits the ball. Problem solved :) 

There's many more changes, including a custom game mode, daily leaderboards, local leaderboards and much more!

It's a large update, and we're a small team, so we do expect some bugs. Please let us know in the forums if you find any. Also, please let us know how you like the new balancing. Too hard? Too easy?

1.4
* Daily Leaderboard
* Local Leaderboards
* Quick Restart
* Fixed: Paddle & Ball Physics (No more lag!)
* Fixed: Saber sounds
* Removed: Sweet Spots on Serve
* Updated: Increased point values across the board, since sweet spots are now harder to get.
* Updated: Re-balance of all game modes
* Updated: Increased bonus point values across the board
* Added: Zen Mode Settings
* Added: Custom Match Mode
* Added: GamePad & Mouse Input for AI controls
* Added: 3 new music tracks
* Added: Intro Scene w/ Credits & Warning
* Added: Game Settings
  - Music / AI Mute
  - Master Volume
  - Playspace - Max Room Height
  - Playspace - Adjustable Wall Padding
  - Playspace - Rotate Playspace
  - Long Press to Pause
  - Bloom Amt
  - Graint Amt
  - AI Particle Trails

notes.title: Update #1: Spectator Mode & 2nd Screen Multiplayer
notes.content:
First off, we wanted to say thanks for everyone for an amazing launch day! Sales exceeded our best expectations, and we're really proud that you all seem to be enjoying HoloBall so much!

The first update is a small one, which restores Spectator Mode and 2nd Screen Asymetrical multiplayer.

* Press [ C ] to cycle available Spectator Cameras
* Press [ SPACE ] to take control of the AI, once you take control of the AI, you can move him arround with [ WASD ]
* Press [ F ] to return to the default first person cam.

Coming in the next update: 

* Achievements
* Settings Menu w/ Music Toggle
* Selfie Mode!

notes.title: Update #1.3 - Expert Mode!
notes.content:
Another day, another update for all you HoloBall lovers out there.

We've heard that the game is a little short, and not quite hard enough, so we've decided to add a 4th mode w/ leaderboard for you hardcores out there.

Expert Mode is similar to Hard, but in a much smaller room, and the AI will not stop at the Sweetspots, so it's quite the challenge.

We will keep an eye on the Leaderboards to see if maybe it's too hard, and please give us feedback in the forums.

Other small fixes include: 
* Performance improvements 
* Fixed issue with AI repeating audio

notes.title: Update #1.1
notes.content:
Hi guys, this is a fairly minor update with some game play tweaks:

* Update Ball Physics to prevent slow spin shots into the corner. You need to actually hit the ball if you want to score! 

* Changed 2nd Player AI cam for a better point of view

* Slightly reduced sweet-spot sizes in all modes.
